title: eval-harness: add prompt-regression CI hook and eval metrics integration
author: Alex Chen
release_notes: Add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks and integrate eval metrics into CI annotations; improves gating for model rollouts.
description: Motivation: catch regressions caused by prompt set changes and surface eval metric regressions directly in CI to prevent bad rollouts. This PR introduces a new CI hook job (eval-prompt-regression) that runs changed prompt-sets through the eval-harness, compares against baseline metrics stored in our metrics service, and fails the job if quality drops exceed configured thresholds. Changes: 1) CI: add 'eval-prompt-regression' job to .github/workflows/ci.yaml with incremental run and caching; 2) tooling: new binary eval_ci_hook (python script) that detects changed prompt files, runs eval-harness locally with preserved seed, aggregates metrics and posts annotated failures to PR; 3) metrics: integration with internal metrics service (http client + auth) to fetch baselines and record run metrics; 4) config: per-repo/dir thresholds and allowlists for expected flakiness; 5) tests: unit tests and an e2e smoke test job. Checklist: - [x] add CI job and workflow - [x] implement eval_ci_hook and metrics client - [x] add config schema and default thresholds - [x] add unit and e2e tests - [x] update docs with usage examples and failure remediation Docs: https://redwood/docs/eval-harness/ci-integration Related Linear: ENG-5123 (prompt-regression gating), ENG-5199 (metrics integration).

review_thread: Priya Nair: This looks solid; two nits: the default threshold feels tight for noisy prompt-sets, and the smoke e2e should run on a smaller sample. Request change.
Alex Chen: Thanks, Priya. I added per-dir thresholds and an allowlist for noisy prompt-sets in eval-harness/config/prompt_regression.yaml; updated smoke test to sample 20 prompts instead of full set.
Diego Morales: Can we avoid long CI runtime by caching eval artifacts between runs? Suggest storing serialized model outputs for unchanged model versions.
Alex Chen: Added caching layer keyed by model_version+prompt_hash; CI uses cache if available. See .github/cache config and tools/eval_ci_hook.py cache logic.
Hannah Lee: Tests pass locally, LGTM. Approving.
CI: initial run failed due to missing metric service creds; re-run after secrets added and all checks passed.
notes: This CI job is opt-in per-directory via eval-harness/config/prompt_regression.yaml; repo owners can tune thresholds.
The metrics integration currently uses a service account token stored in repo secrets: METRICS_SVC_TOKEN.
Follow-up: add dashboards for CI-run eval metrics and alerts for repeated flakiness (ENG-5250).
